implemented_contracts.summary: Added GoalExecutionStatus, GoalExecutionRecord and Store CAS operations with explicit status_version, active_plan_execution_ref, plan_execution_refs, defect refs and repair_cycle.
Added GoalExecution creation, PlanExecution attach/finish, repair-cycle start, defect resolution and completion guards. GoalExecution cannot complete while open defects remain.
PlanExecutionRecord now records goal_execution_ref, parent_plan_execution_ref, parent_plan_digest, reused_node_refs and reused_evidence_refs.
Dynamic fixture creates PlanExecution v2 and runs repair plus terminal reverify through StaticPlanScheduler. Direct repair NodeExecutor calls and helper admission path were removed from the fixture.
PlanExecution v2 marks unchanged nodes succeeded only when reused Evidence refs are current; the fixture fills PlanPatchDraft reusedEvidenceRefs from GateRun-backed current Evidence.
GoalExecution start_repair_cycle increments repair_cycle and fails closed with repair_cycle_exhausted when max_repair_cycles is exceeded.

known_limitations: GoalExecution storage is intentionally in-memory for TASK-0036; SQLite persistence is deferred to TASK-0037.
Generic CLI orchestration is intentionally out of scope and remains deferred to TASK-0038.
The fixture reports deterministic defectTimeToResolutionSeconds as 0 because no durable wall-clock defect lifecycle store exists yet.
